fightOffers.pitch: A fair fight on paper. The kind careers are made of.

fighter.statement: I work days. I’ll be here every night you’ll have me. I’m not here to be famous. I’m here to provide.
fighter.ceilingRead: Handled right, he could surprise some people down the line.

fighter.statement: I’d rather get stopped swinging than win a round running. I’m not afraid of getting hurt. I’m afraid of being ordinary.
fighter.ceilingRead: Bring him along and he could earn his keep on an undercard.

fighter.statement: When I’m in there, something takes over. I can’t explain it. I’m not afraid of getting hurt. I’m afraid of being ordinary. I’d rather get stopped swinging than win a round running.
fighter.ceilingRead: A middling ceiling, but a man can do worse than dependable.

history.text: You signed the lease and put the name on the door: The Kitchen.

recentLog.text: The door is open. The bags are hung. Now you wait and see who walks in.
